browser.executable.description: The browser the server runs pages in (Edge or Chrome, run headless with IED's own profile). Empty: Microsoft Edge, else Google Chrome, where they install.

browser.unloadAfterSeconds.description: A page nobody has looked at and the AI has not used for this long leaves the browser: it stays in Browser Pages and loads again, at its last address, when shown or used. The browser itself stops once no page was loaded for this long. 0: never.
